mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (accommodation_id, user_id, reservation_id, rating, title, content, stay_date, is_verified, status) VALUES (#{accommodationId}, #{userId}, #{reservationId}, #{rating}, #{title}, #{content}, #{stayDate}, #{isVerified}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.username, a.title as accommodation_title FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN accommodations a ON r.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id WHERE r.review_id = #{reviewId}

SELECT r.*, u.username, a.title as accommodation_title FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN accommodations a ON r.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id WHERE r.accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.*, u.username, a.title as accommodation_title FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN accommodations a ON r.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM reviews WHERE accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET rating = #{rating}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE reviews SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as review_count, AVG(rating) as average_rating, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as five_star_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as four_star_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as three_star_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as two_star_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as one_star_count FROM reviews WHERE accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT r.*, u.username, a.title as accommodation_title FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN accommodations a ON r.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id WHERE r.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) as count FROM reviews WHERE accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating DESC

SELECT r.*, u.username, a.title as accommodation_title FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN accommodations a ON r.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT r.*, u.username, a.title as accommodation_title FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN accommodations a ON r.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.host_id = #{hostId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_images (review_id, image_url, is_thumbnail, sort_order, caption) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{imageUrl}, #{isThumbnail}, #{sortOrder}, #{caption})

INSERT INTO review_images (review_id, image_url, is_thumbnail, sort_order, caption) VALUES
(#{image.reviewId}, #{image.imageUrl}, #{image.isThumbnail}, #{image.sortOrder}, #{image.caption})
mapper.select: SELECT image_id, review_id, image_url, created_at, updated_at, is_thumbnail, sort_order, caption FROM review_images WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE review_images SET is_thumbnail = FALSE WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND is_thumbnail = TRUE
UPDATE review_images SET image_url = #{imageUrl}, is_thumbnail = #{isThumbnail}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, caption = #{caption} WHERE image_id = #{imageId}
